studio.title: Brief & success
studio.input: Player need, calendar and business goal
studio.decision: Choose one primary player outcome and a measurable success metric.
studio.output: Event brief, feature scope, owner and success criteria
studio.gate: Avoid conflicting goals such as maximal play time and shortest sessions.

studio.title: Audience & eligibility
studio.input: Progress, tenure, region and account eligibility
studio.decision: Define segment, exclusions, enrollment and cohort rules.
studio.output: Versioned audience query and eligibility reason codes
studio.gate: FTUE suppression, age restrictions, new/returning cohorts and rollout holdout.

studio.title: Rules & economy
studio.input: Core mode, score model and reward budget
studio.decision: Specify entry cost, point caps, tie-breaks and reward tables.
studio.output: Balanced configuration, sources/sinks and duplicate conversion
studio.gate: Review stockpiling, spending advantage, exploit potential and progression inflation.

studio.title: Schedule & surfaces
studio.input: Season calendar, timezones and channel slots
studio.decision: Set teaser, enroll, start, play_end, results, claim and exchange deadlines.
studio.output: Server-time schedule, deep links, slot priority and message caps
studio.gate: Do not interrupt FTUE or gameplay; critical service messages outrank marketing.

studio.title: Configure & localize
studio.input: Approved rules, content IDs and string keys
studio.decision: Bind assets, SKU, reward IDs, localization and accessibility.
studio.output: Draft config version and localized preview for every state
studio.gate: No missing fallback strings, unpriced SKU, clipped translations or unsupported variants.

studio.title: QA & rehearsal
studio.input: Frozen candidate version and test accounts
studio.decision: Rehearse all lifecycle boundaries and adverse outcomes.
studio.output: Test evidence, signoffs, dashboards and rollback rehearsal
studio.gate: Clock boundaries, restart, duplicate claim, no-fill ad, receipt pending and reward overflow pass.

studio.title: Approve & stage
studio.decision: Approve the exact version; schedule a staged rollout.
studio.output: Immutable release version, rollout percentages and rollback target
studio.gate: Use cohort visibility, preview accounts and a kill switch; freeze rules after enrollment.

studio.title: Launch & monitor
studio.decision: Expand only when delivery, fairness and health metrics stay within limits.
studio.output: Launch log and intervention decisions with named owner
studio.gate: Pause or rollback for critical delivery, crash or exploit thresholds; thresholds are project-specific.

studio.title: Close & reconcile
studio.input: Cutoff, accepted results and final standings
studio.decision: Lock scores, audit ties, settle once and apply grace policy.
studio.output: Final results, claim window, inbox fallbacks and compensation
studio.gate: Late results, revoked eligibility, outages and token expiry follow published rules.

studio.title: Learn & reuse
studio.input: Cohort outcomes, player feedback and operational incidents
studio.decision: Compare against baseline or holdout; record cause and change.
studio.output: Readout, reusable recipe and next version backlog
studio.gate: Review retention, participation, reward cost and complaints; do not infer causality without evidence.

recipes: Normal gameplay → capped objectives → claims. Segment by unlocked mechanics. Use server-time reset.
Earn points → thresholds → claims. Show point sources, caps, rewards and grace.
Enroll → cohort → qualifying / final → verified standings → payout. Publish ties and accepted-match cutoff.
Roster → individual contribution → shared goal → eligible reward. Define joining, leaving and minimum contribution.
Normal play → season XP → free / premium tiers → claims → rollover. Show retroactive entitlement and claim policy.
Alternate rules → attempts or tickets → result → reward. Preview entry, caps and retry policy.
Earn tokens → preview → confirm → grant. Define stock, limits, conversion and exchange deadline.
Inactivity eligibility → recap → familiar win → catch-up goal. Cap prompts and preserve progress.
